# graph-manager UI: "Run in sandbox" switch in Start run (KAN-88) ## What to build The Start run drawer (`apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx`) gets a **Run in sandbox** switch, as its own block right below the Provider field: - It is disabled, with the reason, when `GET /api/sandbox/status` answers `available: false` (e.g. "Docker is not reachable at /var/run/docker.sock: connect ENOENT /var/run/docker.sock"). - When available, its hint shows the image the run will use: the workspace's image from `GET /api/workspaces/:id/settings` (`{ image: string | null, sandbox: boolean }`), else `defaultImage` from the status, e.g. `Image: python:3.12-bookworm`; with neither: "No image: set one in the workspace's settings". - Its initial value, each time the drawer opens and each time the workspace changes, is that workspace's saved `sandbox` (the server saves it on every successful start). Turned on while unavailable is impossible (it shows off). - On submit, the body gets `sandbox: true` when the switch is on (nothing extra when off). The server answers the same `{ runId }`, so the toast "Started run …" is unchanged. - The command preview ("Will run") adds a last line ` --sandbox` when on. The server side exists: `POST /api/runs/:ws` accepts a top-level `sandbox?: boolean` and starts the run in a container; `GET /api/sandbox/status` → `{ available: boolean; reason?: string; defaultImage?: string }`; `GET /api/workspaces/:id/settings` → `{ image: string | null; sandbox: boolean }`. Client types `SandboxStatus` and `WorkspaceSettings` exist in `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts`. Spec: `docs/prd/sandboxes.md` (Requirements: "Start run drawer (`StartRunDrawer.tsx`): a Run in sandbox switch…"; user stories 1 and 6). KAN-89 (run options) reworks this drawer in parallel and adds an Options section: keep this as ONE self-contained block (`
…
`) placed right after the Provider `
`, plus small additive changes (state hooks, one key in the POST body, one optional parameter of `commandPreview`). Do not restructure the form. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` (whole file, 259 lines) — `commandPreview(tasksDir, spec, provider)` (34-36), the state hooks (69-76), the open effect (79-83), the inspect effect (92-115, debounced, with a `gone` flag), `submit` (119-138, `post(\`/api/runs/${ws}\`, { tasksDir, spec, provider })`), the Provider field (246-249) and the Will run preview (250-255). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` (whole file) — `stub(post?)` mocks `fetch` by URL (unknown URLs → 404; the drawer must cope: a 404 for the status means "unavailable, reason unknown", a 404 for the settings means `{ image: null, sandbox: false }`), `renderDrawer()`, the tests at 54-120. `commandPreview` is unit-tested there too. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (around line 442) — the only existing checkbox (``), and `pages/Runs.css` for its label style. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/styles.css` and `ui/base.css` — `.field`, `.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error` classes and the colour tokens. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` — `api(path)`; failures throw `ApiError`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` — `SandboxStatus`, `WorkspaceSettings`. ## Patterns to follow Debounced, cancel-safe fetch on change (StartRunDrawer.tsx:92-115): ```tsx useEffect(() => { if (!open || !ws) { setInfo(undefined); return; } let gone = false; ...api(`/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/inspect…`).then((res) => { if (!gone) setInfo(res); }).catch(() => { if (!gone) setInfo(undefined); }); return () => { gone = true; ... }; }, [open, ws, tasksDir, spec]); ``` Command preview (34-36): ```ts export function commandPreview(tasksDir: string, spec: string, provider: string): string { return [`graph-execution ${tasksDir || DEFAULT_TASKS_DIR} \\`, ` --spec ${spec || ""} \\`, ` --provider ${provider} \\`, " --web"].join("\n"); } ``` ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `commandPreview(tasksDir, spec, provider, sandbox = false)`: same lines; when `sandbox`, the `--web` line becomes `" --web \\"` followed by `" --sandbox"`. - State: `const [sandboxStatus, setSandboxStatus] = useState()`, `const [wsSettings, setWsSettings] = useState()`, `const [sandbox, setSandbox] = useState(false)`. - Effect on `[open]`: when open, `api("/api/sandbox/status")` → set; on error `{ available: false, reason: "Could not read the sandbox status" }`. - Effect on `[open, ws]`: load `/api/workspaces//settings` (`gone` flag); on success `setWsSettings(res); setSandbox(res.sandbox)`; on error `{ image: null, sandbox: false }` and `setSandbox(false)`. - `const sandboxOn = sandbox && sandboxStatus?.available === true;` - The block, right after the Provider field: ```tsx
{/* hint: unavailable → reason (field-hint, data-testid="start-run-sandbox-reason"); else "Image: " (data-testid="start-run-sandbox-image") + " · its own container, sees only this workspace" */}
``` While the status is loading, the toggle is disabled with the hint "Checking Docker…". - `submit`: body `{ tasksDir, spec, provider, ...(sandboxOn ? { sandbox: true } : {}) }`. - Preview: `commandPreview(tasksDir.trim(), spec.trim(), provider, sandboxOn)`. - **IMPORTS**: `SandboxStatus`, `WorkspaceSettings` from `../types`. - **GOTCHA**: the switch's saved value comes from the server; do not store it in localStorage. - **GOTCHA**: the test stub answers unknown URLs with 404: keep every existing test green without changing its stub. ### UPDATE the drawer's CSS - **IMPLEMENT**: find where `.start-run-form` / `.start-run-command` are styled (grep `start-run-command` under `apps/graph-manager/src/web`) and append `.start-run-sandbox-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; }` and a disabled style (`opacity: .6; cursor: not-allowed`) under a `/* Run in sandbox (KAN-88) */` comment. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` - **IMPLEMENT** (extend `stub` with an optional map of extra GET answers, without changing existing callers): - `commandPreview("t", "s.md", "fake", true)` ends with `--web \\\n --sandbox`; without the flag unchanged. - status `{ available: false, reason: "Docker is not reachable at /var/run/docker.sock: connect ENOENT" }` → the toggle is disabled and the reason is shown; submit posts no `sandbox` key. - status `{ available: true, defaultImage: "graph-manager:dev" }` and settings `{ image: null, sandbox: false }` → enabled, unchecked, hint `Image: graph-manager:dev`; check it → preview ends with `--sandbox`; Ctrl+Enter posts a body with `sandbox: true`. - settings `{ image: "python:3.12-bookworm", sandbox: true }` → checked on open and the hint shows `Image: python:3.12-bookworm`. - switching the workspace select to the other workspace (settings 404) → unchecked. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Start run shows a "Run in sandbox" switch below Provider; disabled with the server's reason when Docker is not available. - [ ] It shows the image that will be used, and is preselected from the workspace's saved value. - [ ] Submitting with it on sends `sandbox: true`; the command preview adds `--sandbox`. - [ ] Existing drawer tests still pass. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager -- StartRunDrawer` ## Validation commands ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- StartRunDrawer npm test ``` Then look at it as `TESTING.md` "graph-manager" describes (agent-browser, Runs → Start run): once with the server started with `GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=/nonexistent.sock` (switch disabled with the reason), once with the fake Docker (`node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs $GM_DIR/docker.sock --exec` and `GM_DOCKER_SOCKET=$GM_DIR/docker.sock GM_SANDBOX_IMAGE=node:22-bookworm`): switch enabled, `Image: node:22-bookworm`. Take screenshots and look at them.
